reviews.title: Beware of this app!
reviews.text: Very deceptive subscription process. You cannot access the app without signing up for a free trial and entering your credit card information. Even after canceling the subscription, I was still charged once the trial ended. This is unacceptable and misleading. I would not recommend this app unless you want unexpected charges.

reviews.title: Misleading subscription practices!
reviews.text: The app forces you to sign up for a free trial and provide your payment details just to access it. They claim you can cancel anytime, but even after canceling the subscription before the trial ends, I was still charged. Very misleading and frustrating. Be careful before signing up and providing your card details
